visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black-rimmed glasses and a black short-sleeved t-shirt sits at a vibrant orange table in a restaurant. He is smiling broadly as he uses both hands to open a clear plastic bag containing an orange, burger-shaped plush item. To his left is a brown paper bag with a Burger King logo, and to his right is a stack of colorful, burger-shaped containers. (2) A close-up shot of a promotional sign on a counter advertising a burger bag for $199. A hand reaches out to receive two paper receipts from a staff member behind the counter. (3) The man is back at the table, now holding the orange plush bag which is completely removed from the plastic. He looks directly at the camera with an excited expression. (4) Close-up sequence showing the man's hands interacting with the plush bag. He pulls a small metal zipper to open a compartment, points at white felt strips designed to look like teeth or onions, and lifts a green 'lettuce' flap to reveal embroidered text. (5) The man stands up or sits tall to put the black and brown branded strap over his head, adjusting it across his chest as a crossbody bag. He smiles at the camera, showing off the accessory. (6) A real hamburger in a paper wrapper is shown being unwrapped on the table. The man takes a large bite of the burger, winking at the camera while chewing. (7) The man walks confidently through a tiled hallway outside the restaurant entrance, wearing the burger plush bag and carrying the stack of burger containers. He wears black shorts and pink clogs.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice introduces a new product with an excited, fast-paced Mandarin delivery. Upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 beat starts immediately. (2) Sound of plastic crinkling and rustling follows as the voice says he's going to buy it. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect coincides with a visual transition. The music continues at a consistent volume underneath the narration. (4) A distinct 'zip' sound of a metal zipper being pulled is heard clearly. The man's tone remains playful as he describes the bag's features. (5) A magical, shimmering 'sparkle' SFX sounds as he mentions 'perfection.' (6) Wet, percussive biting and chewing sounds are captured as he eats, while the music maintains its bright, major-key energy. (7) The man says 'Happy' in a satisfied tone, followed by the BGM reaching a final rhythmic loop before the track ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Unboxing -> Detail Examination -> Use Case Demonstration -> Final Satisfaction.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a limited-edition Burger King merchandise item (a burger-shaped plush bag) by demonstrating its design, features, and how it looks when worn, while also showing the creator's enjoyment of a real meal.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear focus on the Burger King brand logo, promotional sign, and specific product purchase process.
